args.title: Return 400 Bad Request for malformed JSON request bodies
args.body:
File: src/server.ts

Add an error-handling middleware or handle the SyntaxError thrown by express.json() so that requests with malformed JSON bodies receive a 400 Bad Request instead of a 500 Internal Server Error.
